import click
ctx = click.Context(click.Command('test'))
p = click.Option(['--enabled/--disabled', '-e/-d'])
assert p.get_error_hint(ctx) == "'--enabled' / '-e'"
assert p.get_error_hint(ctx, include_secondary=False) == "'--enabled' / '-e'"
assert p.get_error_hint(ctx, include_secondary=True) == "'--enabled' / '-e' / '--disabled' / '-d'"
assert p.opts == ['--enabled', '-e']
p.opts = []
assert p.get_error_hint(ctx) == "'enabled'"
assert p.get_error_hint(ctx, include_secondary=True) == "'--disabled' / '-d'"
p.secondary_opts = []
assert p.get_error_hint(ctx, include_secondary=True) == "'enabled'"
try:
    p.get_error_hint(ctx, True)
except TypeError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('include_secondary must be keyword-only')
